recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered graphic composition featuring a central soft-edged magenta diamond gradient over a cream background, accented by sharp geometric color blocks in teal, maroon, and red, with a mix of expressive script and bold sans-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Large-scale script overlapping a central diamond gradient
Horizontal and vertical color blocks anchoring the bottom corners
Contrast between soft airbrushed gradients and hard-edged geometric shapes
Diagonal tension created by the central diamond and staggered text placement
coreInvariants: Soft-focus magenta diamond in the center
Teal horizontal bar in the bottom left
Maroon vertical rectangle in the bottom right

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary text occupies the center-left to center-right, while the secondary text is distributed across the bottom third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large magenta diamond serves as the central focal point, while the teal and maroon blocks ground the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large script on the left, moves right across the bold central text, then drops to the teal block on the left and follows the ampersand to the vertical maroon block on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample cream-colored space in the upper right and lower left corners to balance the dense central and bottom elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cream background providing a warm neutral base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Magenta and maroon providing deep, warm tonal contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Teal blue and bright red providing cool and vibrant highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the geometric blocks against a desaturated, high-value background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of copperplate-style script, heavy sans-serif, and condensed slab-serif.
letterConstructionRules: Script: Extremely high contrast, thin upstrokes, thick downstrokes, elongated ascenders.
Main Text: Heavy weight, slight italicization, sharp terminals.
Secondary Text: All-caps, high-contrast condensed forms.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The ampersand is oversized and rendered in a thin, red, sans-serif style to act as a bridge between blocks.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Eclectic mix of formal script, industrial sans-serif, and editorial condensed serif.
graphicDevices: Small gradient square in top right corner

preserve: The overlapping relationship between the script and the diamond
The specific teal and maroon color blocks at the bottom

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, elegant flourishes of the primary script.
Provides the necessary weight and presence for the central text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a cream-colored square background. In the center, place a large magenta diamond with soft, airbrushed edges. Add a solid teal horizontal rectangle in the bottom left and a solid maroon vertical rectangle in the bottom right. Add a small red-to-maroon gradient square in the top right corner.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place large maroon script text overlapping the left side of the diamond. Place bold black uppercase sans-serif text in the center. In the bottom teal block, place white serif text. In the bottom maroon block, place white condensed serif text. Add a large red ampersand between the two bottom blocks.

verificationChecks: Are the teal and maroon blocks solid colors?
Does the script text have extreme contrast?
Is the ampersand red and vertically oriented?

adjustableVariables: Width of the bottom color blocks
Slant of the central bold text
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or album titles
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the cream background is consistent and not white.
Verify the teal and maroon blocks do not overlap each other.
Check that the script text remains legible despite its flourishes.
Confirm the central diamond is centered horizontally.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a soft-focus central geometric shape with hard-edged peripheral blocks and a three-tier typographic hierarchy (Script, Bold Sans, Condensed Serif).
